description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, enabling logging with the ability to chain to subsequent LogNodes for multi-target logging.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility to allow chaining of log nodes, facilitating flexible logging targets.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain where log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Executes the log operation using Android's Log class, and forwards the log to the next node if present. Handles null messages and exceptions.
